name: Jaysynth Orgochem Limited
about: Jaysynth Orgochem Limited manufactures and sells chemicals in India and internationally. It operates through Colorants & Chemicals and Inkjet Printers segments. The Colorants & Chemicals segment offers dyestuffs, digital ink, textiles auxiliaries, pigments, and pigment dispersion. The Inkjet Printers segment provides inkjet printers for digital printing. Further, it offers dyes intermediates; and auxiliaries, as well as printers spares, and related solutions. The company was formerly known as JD Orgochem Limited and changed its name to Jaysynth Orgochem Limited in July 2024. Jaysynth Orgochem Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
